# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall after guided sessions?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (`fixture-001.json`) for the invented learning-gardens domain.
- Trials reporting a learner recall outcome after guided sessions.

## Exclusion criteria
- Any record not present in the supplied fixture.
- Any real-world publication (this review is entirely synthetic).

## Query log
- 2026-10-08 | invented-index (supplied fixture, no live backend queried) | 2 hits

## Notes
- No OpenAlex, arXiv, or Europe PMC searches were run. The corpus is the supplied invented record set.
- Claim/source pairs and synthesis wording are preserved verbatim from the fixture for deterministic integrity evaluation.
The amber garden trial found stable recall (de la Cruz, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found stable recall (de la Cruz, 2025).
